item.text:
# VFX Reference Dossier — vortex_pull

## Candidate 1: Void Sphere (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Void Sphere
- primary_url: [official Heist skill-reveal page with embedded video](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2933919)
- secondary_urls: [official YouTube video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qKERa5ZuP2Q)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: A placed orb emits repeated pulses that visibly draw enemies toward its center, making this an exact inward-pull zone. The showcase captures casting, sustained suction, damage pulses, and corpse consumption.
- readability_notes: The isolated dark core, circular influence, and enemy displacement remain legible at the normal isometric camera. This is the strongest direct motion reference.

## Candidate 2: Vortex Gravity (Lost Ark)
- source_game: Lost Ark
- skill_or_mtx_name: Vortex Gravity
- primary_url: [Destroyer skill showcase video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v7mliS8dC40)
- secondary_urls: [official current ability description](https://www.playlostark.com/en-us/game/releases/thaemine-extreme?language-picker=true)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: At 10:48, the showcase presents the complete hammer strike, gravitational-energy eruption, radial pull, and finishing hit. It offers a compact, forceful version of vortex_pull with a particularly clear impact beat.
- readability_notes: The isolated showcase and large enemy displacement make the inward vector easy to read. The hammer windup also provides a strong anticipatory silhouette.

## Candidate 3: Black Hole (Last Epoch)
- source_game: Last Epoch
- skill_or_mtx_name: Black Hole
- primary_url: [Black Hole-focused video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TKgOgljdnMw)
- secondary_urls: [official Black Hole skill-tree documentation](https://support.lastepoch.com/hc/en-us/articles/46362187384091-Sorcerer-Skill-Tree), [extended build gameplay at 11:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L9pRJDgObas)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The persistent field pulls enemies toward a compact singularity throughout its lifetime, with repeated contact/damage providing the impact rhythm. The focused explanation and extended gameplay together cover both isolated casts and combat-density behavior.
- readability_notes: The central void and surrounding colored rings establish the destination and radius clearly. Enemy movement supplies an especially readable inward vector, although the footage comes from an older beta presentation.

## Candidate 4: Divine Void Sphere Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Divine Void Sphere Effect
- primary_url: [official MTX announcement with embedded video](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2961301/page/1)
- secondary_urls: [official shop page](https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/DivineBlackHoleEffect)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This retains Void Sphere’s exact pull-zone motion while replacing the dark singularity treatment with a bright divine treatment. It is useful for separating the archetype’s essential motion language from any mandatory “black hole” palette.
- readability_notes: The luminous center and circular energy structure maintain strong contrast against the terrain. Treat it as a valuable style-register alternative rather than independent mechanical evidence.

## Candidate 5: Vaal Orb Void Sphere Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Vaal Orb Void Sphere Effect
- primary_url: [official MTX announcement with embedded videos](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3098201)
- secondary_urls: [official shop page](https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/VaalOrbVoidSphereEffect)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The preview preserves the cast-to-persistent-zone-to-pulsed-pull sequence while using a red Vaal-orb treatment. It supplies another clean example of how the same inward motion can survive a substantially different surface treatment.
- readability_notes: The concentrated red core and circular boundary remain recognizable at gameplay distance. Its red energy may compete more with warm or blood-heavy environments than the Divine treatment.

## Search log
- Searched Path of Exile official skill reveals, MTX announcements, shop pages, and official YouTube embeds; verified the base, Divine, and Vaal Orb Void Sphere showcases.
- Searched Diablo III official guides and rune showcases; verified the [Cyclone Strike mechanics page](https://eu.diablo3.blizzard.com/en-us/class/monk/active/cyclone-strike), but found no clean official temporal footage suitable for inclusion.
- Searched Grim Dawn wikis and build videos; results lacked an isolated, clearly documented inward-pull skill showcase.
- Searched Last Epoch official material and videos; found current Black Hole documentation plus focused and extended gameplay footage.
- Searched Lost Ark official class material and skill showcases; found Vortex Gravity with an exact showcase timestamp and current official description.
- Searched Diablo IV Corpse Tendrils footage; found general Necromancer compilations, but no sufficiently reliable official or timestamped isolated showcase.
